scope.credential_boundary: credential values intentionally not read; byte hashes cover file content only

method.blob_hash_algorithm: git blob sha1 of working tree bytes
method.tracked_source: git ls-files index of donor checkout
method.directory_expansion_rule: recursive regular files under each directory reference, excluding __pycache__, .git, node_modules and *.pyc/*.pyo
notes: AllLinesMigrationScope.source_registry and BackendDonorSurfaceInventory.source_file_registry are the same 130 paths.
Every file-level entry has sha256, bytes and lines read from current donor working tree.
Directory references are expanded to files; the original directory reference is retained in reference_origins.
